implications: These upper-end 'all seven' rules cannot be tested on any physical modern/historical chart with correctly computed geocentric longitudes; they are not false human predictions in the usual prospective-test sense because the premise never occurs.
An astronomy-aware rule engine should classify the antecedent as EMPTY_SUPPORT/NOT_TESTABLE rather than report 100% success because no sampled person matches.
Do not infer that all lesser-count configurations or all house-dignity rulership rules are similarly impossible; test each separately.
Under either tropical or uniformly shifted sidereal longitude convention, Mercury–Sun relative angular separation remains constrained.
Precomputed ephemeris assertions should be independently checked if a production engine tries to find an all-seven match.
